unknowns: All resource effects are provisional seed assumptions from pattern data.
Daily state uses deterministic provisional flows; no stochastic failure model exists.
Food servings are not nutrition, crop diversity, preservation, or procurement plans.
Household labor and demand profiles are provisional examples, not resident commitments.
Later visual buildout must not infer real-world buildability from this layout graph.
Maintenance degradation is a provisional penalty model, not measured equipment reliability.
No jurisdiction-specific legal, engineering, health, or building code validation exists.
Provisional crop failure scenario exposes that Sprint 2 servings are not a nutrition model.
Provisional v2 contamination scenario; represents response assumptions rather than proof of water safety.
Provisional v2 outage scenario; represents redesigned reserve and backup assumptions rather than electrical proof.
Proxy geometry is deterministic and symbolic; it is not a site plan or architectural design.
Runtime bundle is a visualization contract, not a safety, legal, engineering, or consent artifact.
Scenario modifiers are provisional and deterministic.
Scenario output identifies design pressure points; it is not a real-world safety certification.
Scenario review context is a stress input, not an actual professional review or legal determination.
Scenario storage use is a simple linear drawdown/refill approximation; no weather sequence, contamination transport, medical outcome, or behavior model is included.
Seasonal multipliers are authored planning assumptions, not site-specific weather or crop calendars.
Setbacks, slopes, drainage, flood risk, fire access, utilities, easements, and code paths are not verified.
Spatial data is not a survey, site plan, permit drawing, or accessibility review.
Storage capacities, reserve floors, release rates, refill rates, and quality clocks are provisional planning assumptions, not engineered tank, battery, pantry, public-health, or sanitation designs.
